description: Deliberate defects seeded into this mock dataset. Each one should be caught by the corresponding INAFIN reconciliation check. Use this as the expected-results fixture for your test suite.

anomalies.description: Supplier APEX INDUSTRIAL SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED amended invoice APE/24-25/9483 in Jan-25; taxable value reduced from 29262.42 to 21068.94. ITC already availed in Nov-24 3B.
anomalies.expected_detection: Excess ITC availed = tax differential; reversal with interest u/s 50(3) expected.

anomalies.description: Outward invoices raised on BENGAL PUMPS AND SEALS PRIVATE LIMITED (19AAACB6677K1Z6) after its registration was cancelled w.e.f. 30-09-2024.
anomalies.expected_detection: GSTIN status at invoice date check must flag these; buyer ITC is void.

anomalies.description: ITC availed on invoices of VISHWA ENTERPRISES PRIVATE LIMITED dated after cancellation (31-12-2024).
anomalies.expected_detection: ITC ineligible; must be reversed. Status-at-invoice-date test, not current status.

anomalies.description: Shipping bill for export invoice VPI/KA/24-25/0057 has EGM not filed.
anomalies.expected_detection: EGM status check - IGST refund / LUT export validation blocked until EGM filed.

anomalies.description: FOB value on shipping bill for VPI/KA/24-25/0098 exceeds GSTR-1 Table 6A value by 6.2%.
anomalies.expected_detection: Three-way match: sales invoice vs GSTR-1 Table 6A vs ICEGATE shipping bill.

anomalies.description: Export invoice VPI/KA/24-25/0037 has no eBRC/FIRC - realisation beyond 12 months.
anomalies.expected_detection: Rule 96A: IGST + interest payable if proceeds unrealised in 12 months absent RBI extension.

anomalies.description: GSTR-1 Table 6A for VPI/KA/24-25/0078 carries no shipping bill number.
anomalies.expected_detection: Invoice-to-shipping-bill linkage missing; ICEGATE-GSTN data flow will not validate.

anomalies.description: Sep-2024 GSTR-3B Table 3.1(a) understates outward taxable value vs GSTR-1 by one B2B invoice.
anomalies.expected_detection: GSTR-1 vs GSTR-3B liability reconciliation; matches DRC-01B notice in B3.02.

anomalies.description: Oct-2024 ITC availed is 80% of GSTR-2B eligible ITC (deferred availment).
anomalies.expected_detection: 2B vs 3B Table 4A(5) reconciliation; recovery opportunity per Circular 183/15/2022.

anomalies.description: Jan-2025 CGST/SGST ITC availed is 106% of GSTR-2B eligible ITC.
anomalies.expected_detection: Section 16(2)(aa) cap breach; excess ITC + interest u/s 50(3).

anomalies.description: Jul-2024 GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B for the Karnataka GSTIN filed after the due date.
anomalies.expected_detection: Late fee and Section 50 interest computation from due date.

anomalies.description: ISD distributed credit to the Tamil Nadu GSTIN for periods before its registration effective date (12-08-2024).
anomalies.expected_detection: ISD distribution must only go to GSTINs registered on the distribution date - Rule 39.

anomalies.description: Amazon GSTR-8 net supply value for POS 29 in Dec-2024 exceeds the seller's own marketplace turnover by 9%.
anomalies.expected_detection: GSTR-8 vs MTR vs GSTR-1 three-way marketplace reconciliation (Section A9).

anomalies.description: RFD-01 for Q3 FY2024-25 has a deficiency memo (RFD-03) and has crossed the 60-day processing window.
anomalies.expected_detection: 60-day refund processing deadline monitoring and interest u/s 56.

anomalies.description: Three B2B/export invoices above the e-invoice threshold have no IRN: VPI/KA/24-25/0012, VPI/KA/24-25/0076, VPI/KA/24-25/0128
anomalies.expected_detection: Invoice without IRN is legally defective (Rule 48(5)) once taxpayer crosses threshold; buyer ITC at risk.

anomalies.description: Two goods invoices above Rs.50,000 have no e-way bill: VPI/KA/24-25/0034, VPI/TN/24-25/0003
anomalies.expected_detection: Three-way match invoice vs EWB vs GSTR-1; movement without EWB attracts Section 129.

anomalies.description: Bill of Entry 3484962 carries IGST paid at customs but is not reflected in GSTR-2B (Table IMPG).
anomalies.expected_detection: Import IGST credit reconciliation: ICEGATE vs GSTR-2B IMPG vs 3B Table 4A(1).

anomalies.description: IEC branch 03 (Chennai) has no GSTIN mapped in the DGFT registry.
anomalies.expected_detection: IEC-GSTIN linkage validation; mismatch blocks refund processing and SB-GSTR1 matching.

anomalies.description: Advance Authorisation 0710098765 export obligation period expired 08-02-2024 with a 25% shortfall.
anomalies.expected_detection: Defaulted EO retroactively affects deemed export / duty-free entitlement claims (Notification 48/2017); customs duty + IGST + interest exposure.
